```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
library(readxl)
library(RNAAgeCalc)
library(knitr)
```

```{r}
prostate_trans_age = read.csv("raw_data/bio_age_prostate_updated.csv")


thyroid_samples = read.csv("raw_data/final_samples_112.csv") %>% 
  dplyr::rename(tissue_type = tissue_type2)
thyroid_rna_counts = read.delim("raw_data/all_samples_genes_counts_2026.matrix")

colnames(thyroid_rna_counts) = sub(".*(SC[0-9]+).*", "\\1", colnames(thyroid_rna_counts))
rownames(thyroid_rna_counts) = thyroid_rna_counts[[1]]
thyroid_rna_counts = thyroid_rna_counts[ , -1]
thyroid_rna_counts[["SC873736_37"]] = rowMeans(thyroid_rna_counts[, c("SC873736", "SC873737")], na.rm = TRUE)
thyroid_rna_counts[["SC873739_40"]] = rowMeans(thyroid_rna_counts[, c("SC873739", "SC873740")], na.rm = TRUE)
thyroid_sample_ids = thyroid_samples$sample_id
thyroid_rna_counts_109 = thyroid_rna_counts[ , colnames(thyroid_rna_counts) %in% thyroid_sample_ids]
```

```{r}
thyroid_chron_age = thyroid_samples %>% 
  dplyr::select(sample_id, chron_age)

thyroid_trans_age = predict_age(exprdata = thyroid_rna_counts_109, tissue = "thyroid",
                                exprtype = "counts", idtype = "ENSEMBL", stype = "all",
                                chronage = as.data.frame(thyroid_chron_age))
```

```{r}
thyroid_trans_age$age_diff = thyroid_trans_age$RNAAge - thyroid_trans_age$ChronAge

thyroid_trans_age = thyroid_trans_age %>%
  rownames_to_column("sample_id")

exposure = thyroid_samples %>% 
  dplyr::select(sample_id, group) %>% 
  dplyr::rename(exposure = group)

thyroid_trans_age = merge(
  thyroid_trans_age, 
  exposure, 
  by = "sample_id"
)

thyroid_trans_age$exposure[thyroid_trans_age$exposure == "WTC Case"] = "WTC Responder"
```

```{r}
library(flextable)
library(officer)
library(gt)

prostate_df <- prostate_trans_age %>%
  mutate(
    group = exposure,
    tissue = "Prostate"
  )

thyroid_cancer_df <- thyroid_cancer_trans_age %>%
  mutate(
    group = exposure,
    tissue = "Thyroid Tumor"
  )

thyroid_normal_df <- normal_trans_age %>%
  mutate(
    group = exposure,
    tissue = "Thyroid Normal"
  )

combined_df <- bind_rows(
  prostate_df,
  thyroid_cancer_df,
  thyroid_normal_df
)

combined_df <- combined_df %>% 
  mutate(
    tissue = case_when(
      tissue == "Prostate" ~ "Prostate Tumor",
      TRUE ~ tissue
    ),
    group = recode(group,
                   "Control" = "Unexposed",
                   "WTC Responder" = "Exposed")
  )

get_group_row <- function(df, tissue_name, exposure_level) {
  
  df_sub <- df %>%
    filter(tissue == tissue_name, group == exposure_level)
  
  tibble(
    Tissue = tissue_name,
    `WTC Exposure` = exposure_level,
    N = nrow(df_sub),
    
    `Average Chronological Age (years)` = mean(df_sub$ChronAge, na.rm = TRUE),
    `Average Biological Age (years)` = mean(df_sub$RNAAge, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    `Average Aging Acceleration (years)` = mean(df_sub$AgeAccelResid, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
}

table_final <- bind_rows(
  # Prostate
  get_group_row(combined_df, "Prostate Tumor", "Exposed"),
  get_group_row(combined_df, "Prostate Tumor", "Unexposed"),
  
  # Thyroid Tumor
  get_group_row(combined_df, "Thyroid Tumor", "Exposed"),
  get_group_row(combined_df, "Thyroid Tumor", "Unexposed"),
  
  # Thyroid Normal
  get_group_row(combined_df, "Thyroid Normal", "Exposed"),
  get_group_row(combined_df, "Thyroid Normal", "Unexposed")
)

table_final %>%
  gt() %>%
  fmt_number(
    columns = c(`Average Chronological Age (years)`, 
                `Average Biological Age (years)`, 
                `Average Aging Acceleration (years)`),
    decimals = 2
  )

```

```{r}
prostate_trans_age = prostate_trans_age %>% 
  dplyr::rename(
    AgeAccelResid = age_acceleration, 
    age_diff = age_difference, 
    exposure = group,
    sample_id = subject_id
  )

prostate_trans_age$tissue = "Prostate Cancer"
thyroid_cancer_trans_age$tissue = "Thyroid Cancer"
prostate_thyroid = rbind(
  prostate_trans_age, thyroid_cancer_trans_age
)
prostate_trans_age$tissue = NULL
thyroid_cancer_trans_age$tissue = NULL

normal_trans_age$tissue = "Normal Thyroid"

all_tissue = rbind(prostate_thyroid, normal_trans_age)

all_tissue = all_tissue %>%
  mutate(
    tissue = recode(
      tissue,
      "Prostate Cancer" = "Prostate Tumor",
      "Thyroid Cancer" = "Thyroid Tumor"
    ),
    tissue = factor(
      tissue,
      levels = c(
        "Prostate Tumor",
        "Thyroid Tumor",
        "Normal Thyroid"
      )
    )
  )

all_tissue$tissue = factor(
  all_tissue$tissue,
  levels = c("Prostate Tumor", "Thyroid Tumor", "Normal Thyroid")
)

pvals = all_tissue %>%
  group_by(tissue) %>%
  summarise(
    p = if(length(unique(exposure)) == 2) {
      wilcox.test(AgeAccelResid ~ exposure)$p.value
    } else {
      NA
    }
  ) %>%
 mutate(
  p_label = paste0(tissue, "\n(p = ", sprintf("%.2f", p), ")"),
  p_label = factor(
    p_label,
    levels = p_label
  )
)

plot_data = all_tissue %>%
  left_join(pvals, by = "tissue")


age_accelplot_final = ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = exposure, y = AgeAccelResid, fill = exposure)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7, outlier.shape = 16, outlier.size = 0.75) +
  facet_wrap(~ p_label, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Control" = "lightblue", "WTC Responder" = "red"),
    labels = c("Control" = "WTC-unexposed",
               "WTC Responder" = "WTC-exposed")) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
  labs(
    x = "",
    y = "Aging Acceleration",
    fill = "Exposure:"
  ) +
  theme(
    strip.text = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )

age_accelplot_final
```
